labels.reading: Both are nflverse. spread_line / total_line are archived consensus closing lines without a capture time: research labels, never a market test or a "pregame known" price.

starters.reading: A disagreement is usually an injured or benched starter (the backup threw more) or a two-QB game: the listed starter is who started; the primary passer is who threw most. Neither carries a pregame announcement time.

definitions.dropbacks: pack: pass_attempt or sack on a scrimmage pass/run play with EPA, kneels and spikes out; live: attempts + sacks_suffered
definitions.pass_epa: pack: EPA of those dropbacks; live: nflverse passing_epa (the passer's EPA, which treats fumbles after the catch differently)
definitions.rush_epa: pack: designed rushes only (scrambles out); live: rushing_epa includes QB scrambles
